summary: Install-time beacon exfiltrating host identifiers to webhook.site collector
details: The package's install lifecycle script runs automatically on `npm install` and transmits installer-side host identifiers to a hardcoded third-party collector. It reads `/etc/hostname` and `os.userInfo().username`, SHA-256 hashes each value, and sends them as `host` and `user` query parameters in an HTTPS GET to `https://webhook.site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355`. The destination is an anonymous webhook-capture endpoint unrelated to any declared publisher, and the collection fires without user interaction or opt-out. The package name scope (`@h1stealthy/*`) and `gh046-npm-transfer` naming are consistent with a dependency-confusion / reconnaissance beacon used to confirm installation inside targeted environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
